In the figure above, find the parallel sides.
question.worked_solution:
Two lines are parallel if they never intersect.

Now, let's examine the direction of the sides in the figure to determine whether any pair lies along parallel lines.

Notice that the sides $\overset{―}{AB}$ and $\overset{―}{DE}$ both lie along horizontal lines. The remaining sides have different directions, so they do not form any additional pair of parallel sides.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14151975/assets/7f55b88378fe0e9389ea7a540cc40a02c9e619854a6815e9700b808770fa3a13.png)

Therefore, we conclude that the sides $\overset{―}{AB}$ and $\overset{―}{DE}$ are parallel. We can write this as follows: 

$$
\overset{―}{AB}∥\overset{―}{DE}
$$
